projection.registration: All imagery and pins share the same exact affine Mercator-to-isometric transform.

imagery.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
imagery.delivery: Direct provider requests for visible imagery; no imagery bundled, generation, warping by hand or synthetic detail.

fallback.source: OSM and Microsoft footprint geometry, ground-only deterministic drawing
fallback.accuracy: Source data may be incomplete or dated; fallback is clearly identified and contains no invented roofs, models, heights or terrain.
